State: The 2014 place of work and migration public use microdata areas
(POWPUMA and MIGPUMA) that are county-based and PUMA-based
and use the same codes.   Prior to 2012, POWPUMA and MIGPUMA in
previous ACS datasets did not use the same codes.
For 2012 and 2013 ACS, the POWPUMAs and MIGPUMAs for Gwinnett
County and Richmond County, Georgia were assigned duplicate codes
of 04000.  Starting with the 2014 ACS, Gwinnett County has a
POWPUMA and MIGPUMA code of 04007.  The PUMA codes for
Gwinnett County are 04001-04006.
In addition, the POWPUMAs and MIGPUMAs for northwestern Wisconsin
(Ashland, Bayfield, Burnett, Douglas, Iron, Price, Rusk, Sawyer, Taylor,
and Washburn Counties) and Dane County were assigned duplicate
codes of 00100.   Starting with the 2014, ACS Dane County has a
POWPUMA and MIGPUMA code of 00104.  The PUMA codes for Dane
County are 00101-00103.
Records affected are listed at the bottom of the 2012 and 2013 MIGPUMA
and POWPUMA code lists.
